name: AiPanel
purpose: A docked or overlay assistant workspace with a conversation, context-aware composer, and cancellable streaming.
description: Drag the left edge to resize on desktop, or focus the separator and use Left/Right arrows (Shift for larger steps), Home, and End. Docked panels reserve 480px for the workspace when space allows. The conversation and draft remain intact while resizing; narrow screens fit the viewport. Set `resizable={false}` for a fixed-width panel.

props.name: request
props.description: Each unique request id is submitted once when the panel is open.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Resizing preserves the conversation and composer; narrow screens remain viewport-fit.

guidance.overview: A docked or overlay assistant workspace with a conversation, context-aware composer, and cancellable streaming.
usage: The default stream is a deterministic local demo. Supply streamResponse for a real service and use modelLabel to describe it accurately.
Each unique request ID is submitted once while the panel is open. Requests snapshot context so later selection changes do not rewrite earlier messages.
Use onEvidenceClick for cited-record navigation and renderResultCards for application-owned results. Resizing preserves the conversation and draft.
accessibility: SideSheet supplies the overlay or docked focus behavior; the transcript is a named log with token streaming announcements kept separate.
The panel exposes stop, context removal, feedback, and regeneration controls without making generated text an automatic action.
intent: AI treatment identifies assistance and provenance. Any state-changing proposal still needs an explicit application action or review boundary.
context: Use beside a workspace when prompts should refer to selected records and their supplied descriptions.
